features: Existing category base panel only; same training-only imputation/missing indicators and role encoding; no new information source
new_learner: One monotonic HistGradientBoostingClassifier with threshold covariate per numeric category/year; one direct binary classifier for anytime TD; fixed grid/parameters in frozen source, no selection
within_bin_law: Training-only empirical frequencies; predeclared boundary integer for empty bins; fixed 5% role/global full-support prior; complete count/signed support, Bernoulli separately
chronology: Annual fits use seasons2019..year-1 with known label availability strictly earlier than first test cutoff; in-season lagged features may use only earlier available games. Forecasts for all years/arms durably freeze before scoring. Labels after2024 never decoded
population: All offered rows in existing primary-role contracts, not selected positive outcomes; sparse/new/cold/unknown offers retain forecasts/fallbacks. Score only supported played valid labels. DNP, played zero, missing, invalid and unknown remain separate
comparators: Fresh paired leaf CDF and role prior for proper scores; count_A corrected mean on six count targets for mean/MSE only. Original raw/SITE/R0 and recorded market thresholds unavailable: N/A

uncertainty.method: paired cluster loss difference, linear percentile; descriptive exposed-development, no selected-winner or simultaneous qualification claim

decision: Per category, pooled2022-24 primary-role offered population only, with all three annual candidate/control cells complete: advance as research lead only if primary distribution CRPS (TD Brier) strictly lower than both freshCDF and prior; equal within absolute1e-12 is tie/retain. No forecast coverage loss. Require absolute mean bias no increase beyond1e-12 and median-point p95 absolute error no increase beyond1e-12 (TD mean probability p95). Report annual reversals; no pooling category units. Missing/failed annual cells prevent research nomination, but explicit common-year descriptive contrasts remain allowed. No automatic provisional selection/deployment/scientific promotion.
failure: Charge before each attempt; retain partial forecasts/models/errors and terminal state, no retry or favorable subset. A failed target does not stop independent valid targets unless shared hard resource ceiling exhausted
publication: Private rows/features/models/paths/expanded ledger never public. Only reviewed source, registration, aggregate results and schemas through explicit allowlist
production: Research package only; existing integrator owns actual provisional entry, scheduler, protected source and deployment
pre_execution_amendment: Metadata/source and decision precision clarified before any semantic NFL decode, fit or score; original registration receipt retained in ledger
